recipes.name: Butter Noodles
recipes.desc: Boiled noodles tossed in melted butter with a little cheese on top. The comfort food of every Nervous Newt and every chef who forgot to buy groceries.
steps: Boil ING_PASTA until it stops wiggling.
Toss the drained ING_PASTA in melted ING_BUTTER; two tosses.
Bowl it and shower with ING_CHEESE.
cx: Too much butter. Wait, no such thing. Forget I spoke.
It's... beige. I wanted a slightly more exciting beige.
recipes.look: Glossy yellow noodle nest in a bowl, cheese flakes on top, a butter pat sliding down the side.
recipes.anim: Butter pat slides around the bowl rim once (prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Butter shimmer sparkles; a calm little steam curl.
recipes.mut: Kitchen Pro widens the boil window; `MUT_143` Noodle Arm chefs toss with an extra flourish (cosmetic).

recipes.name: Mac & Cheese
recipes.desc: Elbow pasta folded into a bubbling three-cheese sauce. Toddler Titans have been known to calm down mid-stomp for one spoonful.
steps: Melt ING_BUTTER, add ING_MILK and ING_CHEESE; stir-toss into a sauce.
Bowl: ING_PASTA folded into the ING_CHEESE sauce.
cx: The cheese pull is weak. I demand a cheese SUSPENSION BRIDGE.
Is this from a box? It tastes like it's from a box. I love it. I'm still complaining.
recipes.look: Bright orange bowl of elbows with a stretchy cheese pull on the spoon.
recipes.anim: Spoon lifts with a long cheese string (prop beam) during ANM_043.
recipes.vfx: Bubbly cheese pop sparkles.
recipes.mut: Spark Blend has no effect here, but `MUT_069` Blender Mouth customers ask for it blended (bark); Kitchen Pro on both heat steps.

recipes.name: Spaghetti & Meatballs
recipes.desc: Spaghetti twirled under bouncy meatballs in garlic tomato sauce. Two meatballs, because three would be showing off.
steps: Brown ING_MEATBALL in ING_TOMATO_SAUCE with ING_GARLIC; two tosses (they bounce).
Twirl the ING_PASTA nest, top with ING_MEATBALL and sauce, scatter ING_HERBS.
cx: One meatball bounced away. I saw it. It's under table four.
Two meatballs? I have two hands, so... fair.
recipes.look: Spaghetti nest with two glossy meatballs, red sauce and green herb flecks.
recipes.anim: Lovebird couples share one noodle (ANM_043 pair variant, meeting in the middle).
recipes.vfx: A tiny heart puff when two customers share; otherwise a steam curl.
recipes.mut: `MUT_277` Orbiting Meatballs customers try to add their own (bark); Hot Hands on the sauté.

recipes.name: Lasagna Tower
recipes.desc: Ten layers of pasta sheet, meat sauce and cheese baked into a tower so tall it has its own elevator music.
steps: ING_LASAGNA_SHEET, ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MEATBALL, ING_CREAM_CHEESE, ING_LASAGNA_SHEET, ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_LASAGNA_SHEET, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_HERBS.
Bake the ING_LASAGNA_SHEET tower with ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MEATBALL, ING_CREAM_CHEESE, ING_MOZZARELLA and ING_HERBS on MED.
Cut one tall slice (2 taps) without toppling it.
cx: The layers are uneven. Layer six is clearly lazy.
It fell over. Now it's Lasagna Rubble.
recipes.look: A tall upright slice showing ten stripes of pasta, red sauce, white and golden cheese, herbs on top.
recipes.anim: Slice wobbles when plated, then stands proud (prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Cheese-crisp sparkle on the top layer.
recipes.mut: `MUT_110` Giraffe Neck (tall) chefs get a 'the view from up here' bark; Many Hands builds two layers per input.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Tornado
recipes.desc: Spaghetti tossed into a spinning funnel cloud with flying meatballs. Served still swirling. Do not stand downwind.
steps: Boil a big batch of ING_PASTA.
Mince ING_GARLIC and ING_HERBS; grate ING_PARMESAN.
Brown ING_MEATBALL in ING_TOMATO_SAUCE with ING_GARLIC.
Tornado toss: spin the ING_PASTA through the sauce; two big tosses.
Twirl into a funnel, launch ING_MEATBALL into orbit, rain ING_PARMESAN and ING_HERBS.
cx: It's barely a breeze. I want a CATEGORY FIVE.
A meatball hit me. Good aim, honestly.
recipes.look: Spaghetti twisted into a spiralling cone with meatballs orbiting on noodle strands.
recipes.anim: The cone keeps spinning on the plate for 3 s (prop rotation tween); meatballs orbit.
recipes.vfx: Swirl lines and a few flying parmesan flakes (Reduced Effects: static swirl decal).
recipes.mut: Customers wearing `MUT_197` Cloud Leg or `MUT_274` Storm Cloud Hat cheer the weather (bark); `MUT_277` Orbiting Meatballs chefs get a free extra orbit (cosmetic).

recipes.name: Tentacle Carbonara
recipes.desc: Creamy egg-and-parmesan carbonara with sautéed tentacle rings and crispy bacon. Silky, squishy, and slightly cephalopod.
steps: Slice ING_TENTACLE into rings; dice ING_BACON.
Sauté ING_TENTACLE and ING_BACON; two tosses.
Carbonara cream: ING_EGG first, then ING_PARMESAN.
Bowl: ING_PASTA tossed in the ING_EGG cream, ING_TENTACLE rings, ING_BACON, extra ING_PARMESAN.
cx: The sauce scrambled. I wanted silk, not breakfast.
Not enough tentacle per noodle. I want a 1:1 ratio.
recipes.look: Creamy pale-gold pasta in a bowl with purple tentacle rings and bacon bits.
recipes.anim: A tentacle ring wiggles on the fork before being eaten (prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Silky sheen highlight on the sauce.
recipes.mut: Tentacle parts give Many Hands; Sea Legs on the sauté; `MUT_029` Octopus Head chefs politely look away (bark).

recipes.name: Glow-in-the-Dark Ravioli
recipes.desc: Ravioli tossed in Glowshroom butter that glows cyan in dim light. Turn off the lights, and your dinner becomes a nightlight.
steps: Slice ING_GLOWSHROOM; grate ING_PARMESAN; chop ING_HERBS.
Sauté ING_GLOWSHROOM in ING_BUTTER until it glows; two tosses.
Plate on the black plate so the glow pops.
cx: It's glowing at me. It's TOO bright. Dim it.
It stopped glowing! Is it broken? Is it sad?
recipes.look: Square ravioli in cyan-glowing butter with glowing mushroom slices, bright against a black plate.
recipes.anim: Glow pulses slowly; brighter when the restaurant lights are dim (client-side light check).
recipes.vfx: Cyan PointLight on the plate (Reduced Effects: emissive texture only).
recipes.mut: Glow Guide (`MUT_083` Firefly Glow Eyes, `MUT_233` Moth Wings) widens the sauté window; moth-family customers circle the plate (bark).

recipes.name: The Infinite Noodle
recipes.desc: A single noodle with no visible end, coiled into a garlic-butter tomato nest. Serve it Perfect ten times and something very long happens to your neck.
steps: Boil ING_INFINITE_NOODLE; feed the spool in as it softens.
Sauté ING_GARLIC in ING_BUTTER with ING_TOMATO_SAUCE.
Coil ING_INFINITE_NOODLE into a nest, ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_PARMESAN.
Plate with the noodle end hanging off the table (it has no end).
recipes.sat: Secret hook: 10 PERFECT servings unlock `MUT_116` Noodle Neck (C13.8)
cx: I found the end. Just kidding. I'm still eating.
It's been an hour. Is this noodle legally a rope?
recipes.look: One impossibly long noodle coiled high on a plate, one strand trailing off the table and out of sight.
recipes.anim: Customer slurps continuously (ANM_043 loop) while the strand scrolls toward them (texture scroll).
recipes.vfx: Infinity-symbol sparkle when served Perfect; counter badge 'x/10' for the secret (UI, not world).
recipes.mut: Serving this Perfect 10 times reveals `MUT_116` Noodle Neck (secret, C13.8). `MUT_143` Noodle Arm chefs wind the spool in half the time (bark).

recipes.name: Pasta Shaped Like the Customer
recipes.desc: Mimic Pasta studies the customer's portrait on the ticket and boils into a noodle sculpture of their exact morph. Eating yourself has never been so flattering.
steps: Knead ING_MIMIC_PASTA while it studies the ticket portrait.
Boil the shaped ING_MIMIC_PASTA gently so it keeps the likeness.
Sauté ING_MEATBALL in ING_TOMATO_SAUCE and ING_BUTTER.
ING_TOMATO_SAUCE canvas, ING_MIMIC_PASTA sculpture, ING_FANCY_FROMAGE cream outline, ING_MEATBALL eyes.
Plate facing the customer so they can admire themselves.
recipes.sat: Likeness bonus: the pasta reads the customer's visible parts, so it always matches — Picky customers count it as 'personalised' (+0, flavour only)
cx: My pasta has a better chin than me. Rude.
You gave me the wrong tail. I have a FLUFFY tail.
recipes.look: A flat noodle sculpture on red sauce that copies the customer's head, ears, horns and tail silhouettes in pasta, with meatball eyes.
recipes.anim: The sculpture copies the customer's last emote frame (client builds the pasta silhouette from the customer's visible MUT parts — SPCV-safe).
recipes.vfx: Sparkle outline traces the silhouette once on serve.
recipes.mut: Built procedurally from the customer's visible parts (head, ears, horns, tail slots, §12); `MUT_021` TV Head customers get a static-noise noodle (cosmetic).

recipes.name: Spicy Lava Lasagna
recipes.desc: Lasagna layered with glowing Lava Sauce, sautéed Lava Peppers and fancy cheese, baked until the top crust cracks like cooling magma.
steps: Slice ING_LAVA_PEPPER; crumble ING_MEATBALL; cube ING_FANCY_FROMAGE.

ING_LASAGNA_SHEET, ING_LAVA_SAUCE, ING_MEATBALL, ING_CREAM_CHEESE, ING_LASAGNA_SHEET, ING_LAVA_PEPPER, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_LASAGNA_SHEET, ING_LAVA_SAUCE, ING_FANCY_FROMAGE, ING_LASAGNA_SHEET, ING_MOZZARELLA.
Bake the ING_LASAGNA_SHEET stack with ING_LAVA_SAUCE, ING_LAVA_PEPPER, ING_MEATBALL, ING_CREAM_CHEESE, ING_MOZZARELLA and ING_FANCY_FROMAGE on HIGH.
Cut a square (2 taps); lava oozes from the cut.
cx: The magma crust didn't crack. Geology has failed me.
Spicy level: polite. I wanted rude.
recipes.look: A dark-crusted lasagna square with glowing orange cracks and lava sauce oozing between the layers.
recipes.anim: Crust crack lines glow brighter when the fork goes in (decal flipbook).
recipes.vfx: Orange glow and steam vents (no flames).
recipes.mut: `MUT_163` Lava Fist Arm and `MUT_034` Lava Rock Head (fire): Hot Hands on the sear and bake; Dragon-family customers ask for seconds (bark).

recipes.name: Pancake Stack
recipes.desc: Three fluffy pancakes, a butter pat and a syrup waterfall. The breakfast that tastes like a hug from a sleepy cloud.
steps: Batter by hand: ING_FLOUR, ING_EGG, ING_MILK, ING_SUGAR.
Cook three pancakes from the ING_FLOUR batter (with ING_EGG, ING_MILK, ING_SUGAR); flip each once.
Plate with the syrup still running.
cx: Only three? My stomach has a fourth-pancake-shaped hole.
The butter is sliding off. Catch it!
recipes.look: Three golden pancakes stacked with a butter cube on top and an amber syrup waterfall down the sides.
recipes.anim: Butter pat slides slowly down the stack (prop tween); syrup drips (texture scroll).
recipes.vfx: Warm steam curl; syrup glint.
recipes.mut: `MUT_167` Whisk Arm and `MUT_173` Whisk Fingers (chef) — Kitchen Pro on the pancakes and a faster hand-mix bark.

recipes.name: Fried Egg Plate
recipes.desc: Two fryer-crisped eggs with lacy edges, grilled bacon, a toasted slice and a grilled tomato. The sunniest plate in the shack.
steps: Fry two ING_EGG in the basket until lacy; shake once.
Grill ING_BACON alongside the ING_BREAD_SLICE toast and a halved ING_TOMATO; flip the bacon.
Arrange on a plate with ING_BUTTER on the toast.
cx: The yolk is shy. I want a BOLD yolk.
One egg is looking at the other egg. It's weird.
recipes.look: Two sunny eggs with frilly golden edges, a crispy bacon strip, toast and a charred tomato half.
recipes.anim: Yolks wobble when the plate lands (prop jiggle).
recipes.vfx: Small sunny sparkle over the yolks.
recipes.mut: `MUT_008` Chicken Head and `MUT_121` Chicken Body customers find it 'complicated' (bark); Hot Hands on fry and grill.

recipes.name: Waffles
recipes.desc: Crispy golden waffles baked in the oven's waffle iron, with butter pooling in every square. Robot Accountants appreciate the grid.
steps: Batter: ING_FLOUR, ING_EGG, ING_MILK, ING_SUGAR, ING_BUTTER.
Bake the ING_FLOUR batter (ING_EGG, ING_MILK, ING_SUGAR, ING_BUTTER) in the waffle iron insert on MED.
Plate two waffles; pour ING_SYRUP into every square.
cx: The syrup missed square 14. I counted.
Too crispy. Wait. Not crispy enough. Wait...
recipes.look: Two thick grid waffles with a butter pat and syrup filling the squares like tiny pools.
recipes.anim: Syrup fills squares one by one (texture flipbook) when plated.
recipes.vfx: Grid sparkle sweep across the waffle.
recipes.mut: Spark Blend speeds the mixer for `electric` parts (`MUT_159` Electric Eel Arm); Kitchen Pro on the bake.

recipes.name: Breakfast Burrito
recipes.desc: Scrambled egg, sausage, crispy hash cubes, peppers, cheese and salsa rolled into a portable morning. Eat it while running late — it was designed for that.
steps: Cube ING_POTATO; dice ING_BELL_PEPPER and ING_SAUSAGE.
Fry ING_POTATO hash cubes; shake once.
Scramble ING_EGG with ING_SAUSAGE; two tosses.
ING_TORTILLA, ING_EGG, ING_SAUSAGE, ING_POTATO, ING_BELL_PEPPER, ING_CHEESE, ING_SALSA, rolled.
cx: It unrolled in my hand. Like my morning.
The potatoes aren't crispy. My life isn't crispy.
recipes.look: A plump burrito cut diagonally showing yellow egg, sausage, golden cubes and red pepper.
recipes.anim: Speedrunner customers eat it in one gulp (ANM_043 at 3× speed).
recipes.vfx: Small steam puff from the cut end.
recipes.mut: `ABL_061` Extra Hands runs fryer and pan together; Many Hands rolls it in one input.

recipes.name: Upside-Down Pancakes
recipes.desc: Blueberries go in the pan first, batter on top, then the whole stack is served toppings-down on a pool of syrup. Time-travellers say it's how pancakes will be eaten in 3024.
steps: ING_BLUEBERRY into the pan first, then pour the ING_FLOUR batter over (with ING_EGG, ING_MILK, ING_SUGAR); flip each pancake once.
Upside down: ING_SYRUP pool, ING_CHERRY, ING_WHIPPED_CREAM, ING_BANANA, ING_FLOUR pancakes berry-side down, ING_BUTTER on top.
Plate as built; never flip it 'back'.
cx: The cherry should be at the BOTTOM. Of the top. You know what I mean.
Gravity is winning. I paid for gravity to lose.
recipes.look: A pancake stack with a cherry and whipped cream squashed underneath, berries studding the bottom of each pancake, butter on top.
recipes.anim: Customer eats from the bottom up (ANM_043 with head under the stack, neck morph).
recipes.vfx: Counter-clockwise sparkle swirl.
recipes.mut: `ABL_069` Hover Serve carries it inverted with no topple; Kitchen Pro on the pancakes.

recipes.name: Omelette of Questionable Origin
recipes.desc: A fluffy folded omelette of ham, mushroom, pepper and spinach — with one gummy eyeball garnish and a hot-sauce dot nobody ordered. Where did it come from? Don't ask.
steps: Dice ING_HAM, ING_MUSHROOM, ING_BELL_PEPPER and ING_SPINACH.
Sauté the filling: ING_HAM, ING_MUSHROOM, ING_BELL_PEPPER, ING_SPINACH.
Pour ING_EGG and ING_MILK into the pan, add ING_CHEESE and the filling, fold; one flip.
Plate with an ING_GUMMY_EYEBALL garnish and a mysterious ING_HOT_SAUCE dot.
cx: Questionable? This is DEFINITELY a question.
The eyeball garnish blinked first. I lost.
recipes.look: Half-moon golden omelette bulging with colourful filling, a gummy eyeball on top and a single red sauce dot.
recipes.anim: The garnish eyeball follows the customer's fork (client look-at).
recipes.vfx: A floating '?' particle appears for 1 s on serve.
recipes.mut: `ABL_064` Super Sniff reveals the origin is... a normal kitchen (joke reveal). `MUT_008` Chicken Head customers refuse to comment (bark).

recipes.name: Cereal With Soup Instead of Milk
recipes.desc: Rainbow cereal, croutons and marshmallows drowned in hot tomato-chicken soup. It's breakfast. It's lunch. It's a cry for help, and it's delicious.
steps: Simmer ING_TOMATO, ING_CHICKEN and ING_CARROT in ING_BROTH with ING_CHEESE.
Bowl: ING_CEREAL, ING_CROUTON, ING_MARSHMALLOW, ING_EGG_NOODLES, then pour the ING_TOMATO soup over.
cx: The cereal got soggy. In SOUP. Who could have predicted this.
Too logical. I want a SILLIER breakfast.
recipes.look: A cereal bowl of rainbow loops floating in red soup with marshmallows and croutons bobbing among them.
recipes.anim: Customer pours the soup from a carton prop at the table (ANM_020 Pour drink reused as a table pour).
recipes.vfx: Rainbow loops spin in the soup (texture scroll); confused '?' bubble.
recipes.mut: Sticky Grip keeps the brimming bowl from sloshing; `MUT_027` Fly Head customers rate it 'gourmet' (bark).

recipes.name: Bacon Waterfall
recipes.desc: Ten strips of crispy bacon cascade off a pancake cliff into a caramel river and a syrup pool. Swimming is not permitted. Eating is mandatory.
steps: Batch 2: fry five more ING_BACON strips; skim first if the oil is Hot.
Cook a thick ING_FLOUR pancake cliff (with ING_EGG and ING_MILK); one flip.
Warm ING_CARAMEL into a pourable river.
ING_SYRUP pool, ING_FLOUR pancake cliff, ING_BUTTER, ING_BACON waterfall cascading down, ING_CARAMEL river, ING_WHIPPED_CREAM foam.
Plate on the tilted waterfall stand.
cx: The waterfall is more of a trickle. I count NINE strips.
There's a bacon drought on the left side.
recipes.look: A pancake 'cliff' with ten bacon strips cascading in a fan down into a glossy caramel-and-syrup pool topped with cream 'foam'.
recipes.anim: Caramel river flows (texture scroll); bacon strips sway gently like a waterfall.
recipes.vfx: Tiny mist puffs at the 'base' of the waterfall (white sparkles).
recipes.mut: Hot Hands on both fry batches; carry-boost parts keep the tilted stand level.

recipes.name: Breakfast-for-Dinner-for-Breakfast
recipes.desc: A clock-face plate: pancake (breakfast), burger patty and roast potatoes (dinner), then eggs and bacon (breakfast again), all brushed with Rewind Glaze so it's always the right meal.
steps: Grill ING_BEEF_PATTY and an ING_CORN cob side by side.
Fry ING_EGG and ING_BACON together; shake once.
Cook the ING_FLOUR pancake (with ING_MILK) glazed with ING_REWIND_GLAZE; one flip.
Clockwise: ING_FLOUR pancake, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_POTATO, ING_CORN, ING_EGG, ING_BACON, ING_SYRUP drizzle.
Plate with the clock hand pointing at 'whenever'.
cx: It's 3 pm. Which meal am I eating? WHICH ONE?
You put dinner at 6 o'clock. Dinner is at 7 o'clock.
recipes.look: A round plate painted like a clock with each food at an 'hour', a tiny clock hand spinning in the centre.
recipes.anim: The clock hand spins backwards once (prop rotation) when served.
recipes.vfx: Rewind swirl particles; tiny 'tick-tock' text.
recipes.mut: `ABL_061` Extra Hands is near-essential (four heat stations); Many Hands places two plate items per input.

recipes.name: Dragon Egg Benedict
recipes.desc: Steam-poached Dragon Eggs on toasted bun halves with ham, spinach and warm Holland-Daze sauce, finished with lava pepper and chili confetti. Each yolk puffs a little smoke ring.
steps: Poach both ING_DRAGON_EGG in the steamer cups.
ING_BUN, ING_SPINACH, ING_HAM, ING_DRAGON_EGG, ING_HOLLANDAISE, ING_LAVA_PEPPER, ING_CHILI_FLAKES.
Plate two benedicts side by side.
cx: The smoke ring was oval. Dragons blow ROUND rings.
The sauce split. Like my heart.
recipes.look: Two towers of toasted bun, spinach, ham and a red-speckled poached egg under golden sauce, with tiny smoke rings rising.
recipes.anim: Each egg puffs a smoke ring every 4 s (FX); customer flinches then grins.
recipes.vfx: Small grey cartoon smoke rings and ember-coloured sparkles (no flames).
recipes.mut: `MUT_031` Dragon Head and `MUT_096` Dragon Fin Ears customers call it 'a family recipe' (bark); Steam Team on the poach; Hot Hands on grills and pans.
